provenance.method: args_schema.model_json_schema() of each tool the wrapper's get_available_tools declares (not commented out), imported from the commit's source tree
provenance.why: Tools the SDK declares that the pinned snapshot (revision b5113a12, 2026-08-07) lacks. S10 #2265. Read by sdk_conformance.rs (merged into the snapshot) and by rust_only_toolkit_tools.json (types), which the Go catalogue merges into the type's argument schemas.

branch.description: The branch to delete the file from
branch.title: Branch

commit_message.description: Commit message for deleting the file. Optional.
commit_message.title: Commit Message

project.description: Project key (Bitbucket Server) or workspace (Bitbucket Cloud) of the repository to use. Leave empty to use the toolkit's project.
project.title: Project

repository.description: Slug of the repository to use. Leave empty to use the toolkit's repository; required only when the toolkit has no repository configured.
repository.title: Repository
